_comment: Pinned canonical values verified by scripts/pull-canonical.mjs against the LIVE sources on every CI run. These are the load-bearing, stable fields (versions + tool counts) — NOT a byte-for-byte snapshot, so volatile fields like the manifest 'updated' date never cause a false drift. When the live API/discovery legitimately changes, bump the value here (and regenerate collections/vectors if the OpenAPI moved) in the same commit that refreshes discovery/agent.json + discovery/llms.txt.
